items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There are people who have made quite a study of it, like Jim Marr, for example... He’s quite an expert in that area.

ctx.x: That must be one part. Were they also less prejudiced by the creators?

I don’t know that there was really prejudice in the United States, except that – there was nothing like race prejudice, because I don’t think that most Americans knew that what they were listening to might be played by black musicians, and they couldn’t care less. But the music was relatively raucous compared to the pap that was being dispensed by the commercial dance bands and the commercial studio bands, and therefore it shook people up more. I’m sure that there must have been clergymen ranting about Tiger Rag…
